# Models pulled ONLY by gpu.yml, on top of .github/test-models.txt. Same
# format: `<backend> <model-id>`, one per line, blank lines and `#` ignored.
#
# WHY A SECOND FILE. The base list is deliberately capped near 6.6 GiB
# because linux.yml falls back to `ubuntu-latest` for fork PRs and those
# jobs pull the whole list through setup-kronk, where the actions/cache
# layers apply and GitHub's cache quota is 10 GB. The models below are far
# past that on their own.
#
# gpu.yml has no such ceiling: all three of its legs are self-hosted, the
# cache layers in setup-kronk are gated on `runner.environment ==
# 'github-hosted'` and so never run for them, and the fleet keeps ~750 GiB
# free on a persistent volume. Models land there once and survive between
# jobs.
#
# So anything a hosted runner could never hold belongs here, not in the
# base list. Adding to the base list instead breaks fork PRs.

# The two speculative-decoding MTP targets. Both drafters auto-enable from
# GGUF metadata rather than explicit config: mtp-Qwen3.6 owns its draft KV
# (sdk/kronk/tests/mtp), while gemma-4 shares the target's via the
# mtp-*.gguf companion (sdk/kronk/tests/gemma4mtp). They are the only GPU
# coverage of the MTP path, which is separate from the classic separate-GGUF
# drafter that sdk/kronk/tests/draft covers with the small Qwen3 pair.
kronk unsloth/mtp-Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-UD-Q2_K_XL
kronk unsloth/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-UD-Q4_K_M
